status: implementation proposal; not a completed runtime config

run_contract.old_training: stop only after final all-family acceptance; retain checkpoint/log
run_contract.outsidewindow: class index 10 only when valid support establishes T > 5.0 s; censor/unknown stay masked
run_contract.provenance_policy: offline availability manifest and focused loader tests; no per-field runtime policing

backbone.component: model.language_model, verified full pretrained text weights
backbone.attention_backend: sdpa or measured compatible optimized backend
backbone.delta_kernel: pin and record actually used backend; verify training backward

data.num_bound_queries: measure each scene from binding registry; no fixed nominal count
data.splits: grouped by original sequence/scene; inherited fixed manifest

if_relation_module_missing.reason: small two-hop relation encoder as engineering starting point, not empirical optimum

graph.time_order: time major, stable scene-local entity slots

semantic.query_text_encoder_initial: frozen native token embeddings + masked pooling + trainable projection

head.exact_predicted_rule_features: reuse available typed executor outputs for same trajectory, never labels/oracle
head.aggregation: softmax over 11 independently, then equal mean over K
head.query_chunk_scope: head only; normalize loss over same full valid query set

loss.coefficients: inherit accepted configuration; resolve before training

optimizer_initial_suggestion.reassessment: check gradients and units; defaults not tuning conclusion

memory.K_memory_path: full parallel small reference; two-pass exact first-order recomputation for real shapes when needed
memory.ddp: one complete B-window and all its K samples stay on each rank initially
memory.profile: load, forward, backward, first optimizer step, steady steps; allocated/reserved plus device free memory

modalities.phase2: entity/time aligned historical sensor features into the graph path; no blanket raw multiview prefill in phase1

must_resolve_before_real_training: real-predicted field availability and missing-data behavior
fixed model and working library/kernel revisions
pretrained weight load and LoRA whitelist verification
